text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, October 10, 2020, Appeal DDRT2021-04.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Mohammed Shinwari and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before March 5, 2021.
